component.name: Seam
component.summary: Your phone and your computer, stitched together

description.p: Seam brings your Android phone's notifications and clipboard to this computer, privately. Pair once by scanning a code. After that, notifications show up here, and what you copy on one is on the other.

ul.li: See your phone's notifications, reply to messages and dismiss them on both
Copy on one, paste on the other
End-to-end encrypted with the Signal Protocol. No account and no server: on the same Wi‑Fi Seam goes straight to your phone, and away from home through Tor

description.p: Needs the Seam app on your Android phone.
